verses.text: Ab'ek ex b'eyum. Elokab' wek'ek'ok eyaw eyok'i, yujto ay niwak yaelal wan sjawi t'a eyib'anh.
Ha he b'eyumal chi' k'aeltakxo, haxo he pichul, toxonhej b'ulanek'i, olchimtakxo yuj nok' nok'.

Icha pax chi' k'een he tumin, chik'takxo k'een. Scheklajel he mul yuj schik'il k'een he tumin chi'. Icha stz'a junok tas yuj k'ak', icha chi' ol aj slajwiel he niwanil yuj schik'il k'een. Te niwan he b'eyumal chi' tze molb'ej, palta ina wanxo sja slajwub' k'ual.
Ha heb' he majan smunlaj t'ayex max he tuplaj heb', tonhej tzeyak' musansatil heb'. Yuj chi' tz'awajchaanh heb' t'a he patik yalan he mul, haxo yaw heb' chi' syab' Dios Yajal t'a Smasanil.

Ha ex tik wach' tzex ek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, b'ut'an yol he pat yuj masanil tastak ay t'ayex. Toxonhej tz'ixtax eyuuj. Icha junok wakax tz'ak'ji serwil yik b'ak'echxo ayik smilchaji, ich ex ta'. Tonhej tzeyak' jab'ok he gana.
Ha ex tzeyak'b'at t'a yib'anh heb' tojol spensar. Ay pax heb' tze milchamok. Palta max spak sb'a heb' t'ayex.

Niwan tzeyutej he k'ool he tanhwan sjaub'al Kajal. Ina heb' munlajwum stanhwan yelul sat smunlajel, haton jun sat te nib'ab'il. Stanhwej heb' yem b'ab'el nhab', stanhwej pax heb' slajwiek' nhab'il k 'inal, palta niwannhej syutej sk'ool heb' yet' smunlajel chi'.
Icha syutej sb'a heb' munlajwum chi', icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a he tanhwan sjax Kajalil. Tek'tek' tzeyutej he b'a, yujto toxo ol jaxok.
Manh eyeklaj he patikok junjun ex, yik manh ol ak'jokoch t'a eyib'anh, yujto toxo ol ja jun ol onh ch'olb'itanok.
Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', a heb' schekab' Dios alannak el slolonel Dios chi' t'a peka', techajnak yuj heb' yab'an syail. Niwan yutejnakpax sk'ool heb'. Yuj chi' b'eyb'alejek sb'eyb'al heb' chi'.

Kojtak to a heb' ak'annak techaj chi', tzalajk'olal yaj heb' tiknaik. Naekkot yab'ixal winhaj Job. Tek'an yutejnak sb'a winh yab'an syaelal. Naekpaxkoti, chajtil ajnak winh yuj Kajalil t'a slajwub'alxo, yujto ok'nak sk'ool t'a winh, ochnak pax pitz'an t'a sk'ool Kajalil chi' yuj winh.

Palta ay wal junxo ol wal t'ayex to yowalil tze wach' k'anab'ajej. Manh he komon lokej sb'i Dios ay t'a satcha'anh, ma sb'i junokxo mach, ma sb'i junokxo tas ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ichaokab' tik tzeyutej he loloni. Tato yel, Yel, xe chinhej. Tato maay, Maay, xe chinhej, yik manh ol kotkan t'a eyib'anh.
Tato ayex wan eyab'an syail tiknaik, lesalwanhek. Tato ayex ay he tzalajk'olal jun, b'itananhek t'a Dios.
Tato ayex penaay ex, awtejek heb' anciano yik iglesia. Ha exxo anciano ex, lesalwanhek yuj heb'. Tze sukanek' aceite t'a heb' t'a sb'i Kajal.

Tato tzeyak'och Dios t'a he k'ool ayik tzex lesalwi yuj heb', ol kolchajel heb' t'a syaelal chi'. Haxo Kajalil ol ak'an b'oxok sk'ool heb'. Tato ix och smul heb' jun, ol ak'jok lajwok smul heb' chi' yuj Dios.
Yuj chi', al-lajek k'eta he mul t'ayex junjun ex. Tzex lesalwi eyuj junjun ex, yik wach' ol b'oxok he k'ool. Ha slesal heb' tojol spensar, tzijtum wal tas sb'o yuj.
Ayik yek'nak winhaj Elías t'a peka', anima winh icha onh tik. Lesalwinak winh t'a smasanil sk'ool yik max yak' nhab'. Nanhal schanhil ab'il majxo yak'laj nhab' t'a jun lugar chi'.
Hato yik slesalwinakxi winh, ichato chi' yak'anxi nhab'. Ichato chi' syaxb'inakxi sat lum lum.
Tato ay mach t'a he kal syik'el sb'a t'a slolonel Dios te yel, komonok ayex junok ex tzeyek sna'a yik wach' syak'xioch sb'a t'ay.
Nachajokab'el jun tik eyuuj. Ha junok mach tz'ekan sna'a yik syaktejkan schukal, wan skolanelta t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Yuj chi' ol lajwok jantak smul chi'.
